benchmarks.name: Payment Initiation Latency
benchmarks.description: Measures round-trip payment initiation latency including routing and database state logging.
benchmarks.notes: P95 measured at 17.2587ms, well within the 200ms SLA.

benchmarks.name: Sustained Throughput Under Concurrency
benchmarks.description: Measures concurrent execution capacity and zero error rate under high request burst.
benchmarks.notes: Zero failures observed across 100 concurrent authorizations.

benchmarks.name: Webhook Ingestion-to-Processed Latency
benchmarks.description: Measures end-to-end latency from webhook ingress to final PostgreSQL state transition.
benchmarks.notes: P99 measured at 185.811ms, significantly faster than 2000ms SLA.

benchmarks.name: Failover Routing Decision Overhead
benchmarks.description: Measures score evaluation, penalty adjustment, and secondary route selection latency.
benchmarks.notes: Intelligent routing decision completes in 1.7556ms average.

benchmarks.name: Concurrent Idempotency Resolution
benchmarks.description: Measures cached key lookup and SHA-256 deterministic payload match speed.
benchmarks.notes: Duplicate key resolution returns cached replay in 0.8449ms.

benchmarks.name: Reconciliation Batch Processing Throughput
benchmarks.description: Measures bulk scanning, ledger matching, and settlement anomaly detection speed.
benchmarks.notes: Projected throughput of 23052 tx/min surpasses the 1,000 tx/min target.
